ssml: days of the week,<break time='1500ms'/>
ssml: or names of months.<break time='1500ms'/>
ssml: We call these nouns proper nouns.

hint.text: Proper nouns are names of people, places, days of the week or months. They start with a capital letter.

instruction.text: Is the word a proper noun? Listen and fill in the first letter of the word.

wrong.text: Days of the week are proper nouns. They are always written with a capital letter.
Names of places are proper nouns. They are always written with a capital letter.
The word spoon is not a proper noun. It is written with a small letter.
The name Anna is a proper noun. It is written with a capital letter.
Names of months are proper nouns. They are always written with a capital letter.
The word friend is not a proper noun. It is written with a small letter.
The word book is not a proper noun. It is written with a small letter.
